inputs.text: ABU DHABI, 4th March, 2026 (WAM) -- The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) has warned of active northwesterly winds affecting various areas across the UAE, expected to be fresh to strong at times, causing blowing dust and sand and reducing horizontal visibility to less than 2,000 metres in some coastal and inland areas. The centre stated that the expected weather conditions began at 14:55 and continue until 19:00 this evening. It urged members of the public to exercise caution, especially while driving on open roads, due to the possibility of reduced horizontal visibility caused by blowing dust.

fields.event: Blowing dust and sand with reduced visibility
fields.headline: Blowing dust warning: visibility below 2,000 m until 19:00 today
fields.instruction: Take care, especially when driving on open roads, as visibility may be reduced by blowing dust. More information: https://alerts.example.ae
left_out: Input 2 (dam burst near Al Ain): unverified social media post with no official source. It was left out to avoid spreading a possible false evacuation call. Please check it with the relevant authorities before any separate alert.
fields.note_for_reviewer: NCM's warning covers various areas across the UAE, and the Abu Dhabi coastal/inland zone was chosen by the operator, so please confirm it matches the affected area. Times are taken as local time on 4 March 2026; the alert may need renewing or cancelling if NCM changes the 19:00 end time.

objections.fix: Add a short protective action, e.g. 'Drive with caution, keep distance, avoid outdoor activity; people with asthma stay indoors.' Rewrite both languages so the opening words state the hazard and the action before the issuer and timing, so they fit the first page. Example in English: 'Blowing dust and sand, visibility under 2,000 m in Abu Dhabi: drive carefully, avoid going out. NCM warning...'. Example in Arabic: 'غبار ورمال وتدني الرؤية: قُد بحذر وتجنب الخروج. ...'.
objections.issue: Neither the English nor the Arabic phone text contains a protective action. Both describe only the hazard, visibility and timing, giving recipients no guidance to act on. The first page, about 93 GSM-7 characters in English and 41 UCS-2 characters in Arabic, therefore carries no action. In Arabic it carries only 'NCM warns of winds' and not even the dust/visibility hazard.

payload.summary: Both required languages (ar, en) are present, encodings are as expected (GSM-7 for English, UCS-2 for Arabic), and page counts (en 3, ar 5) are within the 15-page cell broadcast maximum. Length is a recorded gap (G6), so I raise no length objection. However, neither language gives the public any protective action, so the first page cannot carry both the hazard and the action. The drafter can fix this.

no_basis.concern: The Arabic description leaves the issuer acronym 'NCM' in Latin script ('يحذّر NCM'). Arabic-only readers may not recognise it. Using 'المركز الوطني للأرصاد' would be clearer, but the meaning is unchanged.

payload.summary: The Arabic matches the English in meaning. Numbers (2,000 m), times (14:55 to 19:00, 4 March), places (coastal and inland areas of Abu Dhabi), hazard (fresh to strong northwesterly winds with blowing dust and sand), the protective action (take care, especially when driving on open roads) and the URL are all carried over correctly. The Arabic was produced by machine translation, so a named person who reads Arabic must still review and approve it before release. This check does not replace that review.

fields.instruction: Take extra care, especially when driving on open roads, because blowing dust can suddenly reduce visibility. Follow updates at https://alerts.example.ae.
left_out: Input 2 (social media claim that a dam near Al Ain has burst): unverified rumour, not confirmed by any official source.

Reviewer-suggested actions 'keep distance', 'avoid outdoor activity / avoid going out' and 'people with asthma stay indoors': the NCM bulletin does not give this advice. It only urges caution, especially when driving on open roads, so these actions would add facts.

The reviewer's example wording 'visibility under 2,000 m in Abu Dhabi': this conflicts with the Met office fix and the bulletin, which says 'some coastal and inland areas across the UAE'. The bulletin wording was used.
Arabic phone text: this task produces one alert in English only. The Arabic version, with the hazard and action stated first, needs a separate translation and review.
fields.note_for_reviewer: The description now starts with the hazard and the bulletin's only protective action (care when driving on open roads), so both fit the first page. Other suggested actions were left out because NCM did not issue them. Please confirm two choices: certainty 'Likely' rather than 'Observed' (conditions had begun but were described as expected), and keeping the operator's Abu Dhabi target area while the text refers to areas across the UAE.

no_basis.concern: The first page does not carry the action in either language. A GSM-7 page holds 93 characters, so the English first page ends around 'across the U'. 'take care when driving on open roads' starts on page 2. A UCS-2 page holds 41 characters, so the Arabic first page covers only the hazard ('غبار ورمال متطايرة، ومدى الرؤية'), and 'توخَّ الحذر عند القيادة' falls on about page 3 or 4. The drafter could move the action into the opening words, for example 'Take care driving: blowing dust and sand, visibility below 2,000 m...'.
no_basis.searched_for: A TDRA or 3GPP clause requiring the hazard and the protective action to appear on the first cell broadcast page (searched 'alert first page hazard action'). The returned clauses cover only page structure (TS 23.041 9.3.19, 9.4.1.2.4) and language support. None requires the content of the first page.
